provenance.context: Uploaded after navigating the Tamil Nadu empanelment / TPA hospital directory.
provenance.caution: The CSV does not embed its original download URL or a current active/closed status. Confirm the portal query and publication status before describing this as a complete or current statewide hospital register.

limitations: This export contains 2,157 empanelment/TPA records, not necessarily every registered healthcare establishment in Tamil Nadu.
All 38 current district labels are represented after conservative spelling/alias normalization.
The export contains no phone, website, coordinates or explicit current operational-status field.
The EDC date is preserved as a source date; it is not interpreted as proof of current operational status.
DDWO, CCH, GOI, autism-support and ambiguous entries are kept separate or flagged for manual review.
Three source ownership hints conflict with facility-name/category clues and are marked unknown pending review.
No duplicate source entity codes were found in this export.
